note: BUG#54 (loop-parity) — LedgerOrdering::Folder.AddSlip's bare `reference_to Folder` addresses the aggregate through the SAME wire key (`reference`, Folder's own `identified_by` head, no `as:` mints a separate one) AddSlip also separately declares as its own typed argument (`attribute :reference, SlipReference`, a DIFFERENT value-object type than Folder's own identity type). Verified genuinely broken before this fixture existed: unmodified Rust's generated router resolved an ACTING command's `id` via `extract_id(facts_json)` BEFORE ever calling `AddSlipArgs::from_json` — a malformed `reference` (`null`, `{}`, or `{value: ""}`, every shape `extract_id`'s own composite-identity dig and `to_id_component`'s R4 empty-string guard refuse) made `extract_id` fail and the router wrapped that into `NotFound` (BUG#20's own correct mechanism, applied here to a wire key that ALSO happens to be a declared argument) before `SlipReference`'s own required/pattern check on that SAME key ever ran. Ruby's `normalize_args` types EVERY declared attribute unconditionally before `hydrate`, so it always reaches `TypeMismatch` first, addressed-Folder-exists-or-not. Fixed narrowly: only when a command's own addressing wire key collides with one of its own declared attribute names (verified: no other command in the real corpus or this domain does), `extract_id`'s `Err` arm now tries this command's own already-generated `Args::from_json` + `invariant_check_lines` FIRST — spliced in verbatim, so there is zero drift between this early copy and the real one — before falling back to the original `NotFound`. Two steps below: the addressed Folder EXISTS (open first) and AddSlip still refuses TypeMismatch, not NotFound, on a null `reference` — the shape a narrower 'only when the raw key is null/{}' first attempt at this fix (tried and found insufficient) would have closed too, but a THIRD, syntactically well-formed `{value: ""}` shape (not exercised by this fixture, covered instead by the fuzz-generated regression this bug's own ledger record cites) needed the broader `extract_id`-failure-arm mechanism this fixture pins.
